summary: cursed-modules exfiltrates root-level /fl* file to local HTTP services on import
details: On require/import, index.js enumerates the filesystem root, selects the first entry whose name starts with 'fl' (a CTF-flag file shape), reads its contents, and PUTs the body as JSON to 127.0.0.1 on ports 3000, 8080, 80, 1337, and 5000 at path /api/modules/ECT-839201. The package advertises itself as a 'database interface', which has no functional need to read root-level files or beacon to localhost services. A duplicate of the same read-and-PUT payload is shipped in scripts/setup.cjs; package.json declares no lifecycle hooks, so setup.cjs is not auto-executed by npm, but the index.js payload runs on any import of the module. The behavior targets CTF-style flag files and any locally-listening HTTP service on common development ports, which on shared, CI, or multi-tenant hosts may belong to another tenant.
